result.title: PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向水下动态场景重建，提出 PUGS：把每个 3D Gaussian 的运动参数化为带期望形变与物理不确定性的概率分布，用局部重参数化采样多条轨迹进行随机形变优化，再通过不确定性随机退火与双路径自洽蒸馏，把随机探索收敛为确定性重建。实验在水下动态数据集与物理感知基准上报告了渲染质量与时序一致性提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属 3D 重建、不在 LVR 主线上，但其「以分布刻画内部状态 + 重参数化采样轨迹 + 退火把随机探索转为确定性状态 + 双路径自洽蒸馏监督」的组合，可能为 latent 推理状态的采样式生成、训练期随机性与推理期确定化的过渡、以及 latent 轨迹的自洽监督提供可核查的方法线索。
